bluejetty:00024969:ios.description:
Learn math with the innovative Ahaaa Math app! Ahaaa Math is a fun, engaging app for mastering math skills through interactive, game-based lessons, offering a perfect balance of math and play. Practice counting, adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing while building your number sense and problem-solving skills.
Designed by math experts and loved by millions of families in Asia, Ahaaa Math helps your child excel in math from PreK to Grade 5 with CCSS-aligned content and activities.
Whether your child is in preschool, kindergarten, or elementary school, our app adapts to their learning level, ensuring they are challenged and motivated. Our game-based approach makes math practice a natural part of playtime, helping kids build confidence and a love for learning math.
WHY AHAAA MATH?
Ahaaa Math offers the perfect balance of math and play.
- Truly Game-Based Design. Math is in every move, making learning feel like play. Kids solve math problems naturally while playing, no need to solve problems just to unlock items. They won't even notice they're learning!
- Immersive Experience. Using engaging storylines, music, and real-world scenarios to create a positive and focused learning environment, helping children become confident math learners.
Ahaaa Math works.
- Proven Method. Using the Singapore CPA (Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract) method to make math visible and hands-on, ensuring thorough understanding of math concepts. 
- Structured Learning. Learn-Practice-Quiz-Evaluate system guarantees each concept is mastered. Just 15 minutes a day for 4 weeks can show significant improvement in math skills.
- Engaging and Motivating: Ahaaa Math offers over 5000 CCSS-aligned games and activities, covering everything from basic counting to advanced arithmetic, shape recognition, telling time, and unit conversion. Engaging challenges and a leaderboard motivate kids to learn independently, making math fun and rewarding.
Track progress easily. 
- 13-level learning system adapts to each child’s age and ability, providing a customized learning path and trackable progress reports.
Trusted by millions. 
- Ahaaa Math has brought the joy of learning to over 5 million families in Asia.
Family-friendly use. 
- One account supports up to 3 devices, making it cost-effective for families with multiple children. 100% ad-free and KidSAFE certified 
AWARDS
- kidSAFE Certified
- Mom's Choice Awards Gold Recipient
- National Parenting Product Awards Winner
- Tillywig Toy Awards Winner
- Xiaomi App Store - Golden Mi Award
- Huawei App Store - Craftsmanship Award
- Vivo App Store - the Aurora Award
SUBSCRIPTION
Become a member for $8.99/month with a 3-day free trial, or $59.99/year with a 7-day free trial. Enjoy full access to our app, including unlimited content, immediate tutoring, and learning analyses.
- Pricing may vary by country. Your subscription will be charged through your iTunes account at purchase confirmation and will automatically renew 24 hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renewal is turned off.
- Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime in your iTunes account settings. No refunds for unused portions.

Privacy Policy: https://cdn.mathufo.com/static/docs/mathup_privacy_en.html

bluejetty:00023154:ios.summary: Ora Weather Radar tells you what the weather means for you, not just what it is: what to wear, when the rain starts, whether your plans hold. Live radar shows rain moving toward you, with timing for the next 15 minutes so you know whether t
bluejetty:00023154:ios.description:
Ora Weather Radar tells you what the weather means for you, not just what it is: what to wear, when the rain starts, whether your plans hold. Live radar shows rain moving toward you, with timing for the next 15 minutes so you know whether to wait it out. And when severe weather moves in, Ora tells you what's happening, what to do, and when it's over.
What you get for free:
* A clear daily forecast, tailored to your location
* Live weather radar to see rain as it moves toward you
* A 7-day forecast to plan the days ahead
* Governmental advisories from NOAA
* Rain timing for the next 15 minutes, so you know whether to wait it out
* Evening report with tomorrow's forecast
Get the full picture with OraPlus:
* Full precipitation radar, minute by minute, up to 12 hours ahead
* A 14-day forecast, hour by hour, for planning you can trust
* Hurricane tracker with the full storm path
* Storm cells, lightning, and detailed wind maps
* Morning and evening reports for every location you care about
* All custom notifications
* Wildfires on the radar map
* No ads, ever
Ora Weather Radar works on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, with home screen widgets that keep the forecast one glance away.

bluejetty:00037788:ios.description:
Listen to the radio stations you love with the official app from the radio industry.
Download Radioplayer FREE today and start your listening experience! 
- No registration required 
- Free 
- High-Quality Sound 
- Available on all your devices with Bluetooth, Airplay, CarPlay, Apple Watch, Smart Device Link
- Personalised content recommendations based on your preferences
New: 
- Easy access: Listen to your favourites directly from the homepage 
- Continuous listening: switch between devices without missing a beat. 
- Sync your favourites between mobile and Smart TV.
- Sync your favourites between your different smartphones.
HOW DOES IT WORK? 
1/ Select your country 
2/ Choose your favourite radio stations & podcasts
3/ Choose your city to get local radio suggestions
Enjoy easy access to your favourites & recently listened content directly on the homepage.
INTUITIVE AND EASY 
It’s easy to use and with some powerful features which will help you enjoy radio even more:
- Personalised recommendations based on your preferences 
- Ultimate search function to help you discover new radio stations and podcasts
- Download podcasts for offline listening 
- Notifications to remind you about new episodes of your favourite shows and podcasts
- Alarm Clock: Wake up to your favourite radio station
- Sleep Timer: Fall asleep to the music your love
- Find the names of the songs and artists currently playing on your favourite radio station
CAR LISTENING: 
- Voice control to skip safely through your favourite radio stations while driving
- Great Apple CarPlay support and ‘Wrong Way Driver’ technology to alert you to motorway dangers
- Easy Mode for playing your favourites with one tap
SEAMLESS LISTENING
Enjoy smooth and uninterrupted transition between devices.
It means that you for example can start listening on the phone without pausing, and then switch the listening to your Smart TV without any disruption. 
HIGH-QUALITY SOUND 
Enjoy crystal-clear audio, optimised for both mobile data and speakers. We use HQ streams direct from broadcasters, which other apps can’t access.
On the go, Radioplayer switches to mobile-friendly streams to reduce your data consumption.
FOLLOW NEWS AND SPORTS LIVE 
Stay informed with live news 24/7 and sports events. 
Listen to the most recongised voices in your country and also all the local content that is relevant to you. 
LISTEN TO MUSIC 
With our musical radios, listen to the best rap, pop, rock, R&B, indie, dance,electro, classical, and jazz hits…
BROADEN YOUR HORIZONS 
Explore a genre of radio stations and podcasts with searches by themes: Kids, Business, Entertainment, World Music, Religion and many more
Radioplayer Worldwide, Ltd. is a not-for-profit company, aimed at making radio listening easier in connected devices, operating in 22 countries: Austria, Belgium, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Norway, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, The Netherlands, United Kingdom
A SUGGESTION 
Do you like Radioplayer? Support us by leaving us a review
Do not hesitate to send us your suggestions for making Radioplayer even better!
For more information, Radioplayer.org

OvpnSpider will automatically search for free VPN servers on the Internet; and the result is provided as an OpenVPN profile which is categorized by countries. 
User can connect to the VPN server in-app directly.

===============================================
User also can export OpenVPN Profile .ovpn to other Applications.
--Clicking the share icon on the list will launch a popup view of the available applications.

bluejetty:00014914:ios.description:
Discover Zoom Zoom, an incredibly efficient transportation app that offers private cars with highly qualified drivers, who guarantee a secure journey with a superior quality of service. With just a few minutes’ wait, you’ll have a car and driver ready to take you wherever you wish to go.
So how does Zoom Zoom work?
1. Start by ordering or reserving your journey. All you need to do is open the app and let us know your current location and your desired destination. Choose from our various vehicle types – ZoomGo, ZoomSUV, ZoomLuxury, and more – and explore the options available in your city!
2. Then, simply confirm your journey and your driver will be on their way. We will provide you with your driver's name and your vehicle's information, such as its license plate and the distance of arrival.
3. We will also inform you of the estimated price of the ride before you travel , which you can pay with credit or debit cards, cash, or any other payment method that you find suitable.
4. Moreover, you can also share the details of your journey with family or friends so that they can track your whereabouts for additional safety.
In the Zoom Zoom app, you have the opportunity to personalize your journey. Select your preferred music, take advantage of the opportunity for female drivers to specify a preference to accept trip requests only from female passengers, or decide how many seats are necessary for an enjoyable trip.
Where is Zoom Zoom available?
Zoom Zoom is offered in more than 25 cities across the United States and Canada. You can check out the full list of cities where the app operates on zoom.cab.
So, what are the advantages of the Zoom Zoom app?
For one, your safety is always our priority. Every journey is tracked and can be instantly shared with someone you trust so that they always know where you are. 
Furthermore, signing in is simple and convenient, as you can use your email address and password. 
You also have the option to save your most frequently visited locations by clicking the ‘heart’ icon located at the right-hand side of the search bar. 
Additionally, our drivers have all undergone a very selective onboarding process, ensuring they provide the best service possible.
And finally, you can use one single account to travel in multiple cities, which is ideal for those who love to travel!
Do you want to be a driver with Zoom Zoom?
If you’re passionate about helping others explore their city, join the fleet of Zoom Zoom drivers! Start to earn money with the help of an app that values your safety and provides you with the best fares. For more information, go to zoom.cab/drivers or download the Zoom Zoom Drivers app.
Are you looking for corporate transportation options for your business?
Then look no further! Our corporate service offers your business an expansive fleet of cars to meet all of your company's requirements. Plus, you can use our management platform to easily monitor your employees’ expenses and journeys. Learn more by visiting zoom.cab.

1.	Start by ordering or reserving your journey. All you need to do is open the app and let us know your current location and your desired destination. Choose from our various vehicle types – ZoomGo, ZoomSUV, ZoomLuxury, and more – and explore the options available in your city!

2.	Then, simply confirm your journey and your driver will be on their way. We will provide you with your driver's name and your vehicle's information, such as its license plate and the distance of arrival.


3.	We will also inform you of the estimated price of the ride before you travel , which you can pay with credit or debit cards, cash, or any other payment method that you find suitable.

4.	Moreover, you can also share the details of your journey with family or friends so that they can track your whereabouts for additional safety.


In the Zoom Zoom app, you have the opportunity to personalize your journey. Select your preferred music, take advantage of the opportunity for female drivers to specify a preference to accept trip requests only from female passengers, or decide how many seats are necessary for an enjoyable trip.

Where is Zoom Zoom available?

Zoom Zoom is offered in more than 25 cities across the United States and Canada. You can check out the full list of cities where the app operates on zoom.cab.

So, what are the advantages of the Zoom Zoom app?

For one, your safety is always our priority. Every journey is tracked and can be instantly shared with someone you trust so that they always know where you are. 

Furthermore, signing in is simple and convenient, as you can use your email address and password. 
You also have the option to save your most frequently visited locations by clicking the ‘heart’ icon located at the right-hand side of the search bar. 

Additionally, our drivers have all undergone a very selective onboarding process, ensuring they provide the best service possible.

And finally, you can use one single account to travel in multiple cities, which is ideal for those who love to travel!

Do you want to be a driver with Zoom Zoom?

If you’re passionate about helping others explore their city, join the fleet of Zoom Zoom drivers! Start to earn money with the help of an app that values your safety and provides you with the best fares. For more information, go to zoom.cab/drivers or download the Zoom Zoom Drivers app.

Are you looking for corporate transportation options for your business?

Then look no further! Our corporate service offers your business an expansive fleet of cars to meet all of your company's requirements. Plus, you can use our management platform to easily monitor your employees’ expenses and journeys. Learn more by visiting zoom.cab.

bluejetty:00015947:ios.name: Acrostic Crossword Puzzles
bluejetty:00015947:ios.summary: Acrostic puzzles are crosswords with a twist: find the hidden quote. This combination of crossword and cryptogram provides an entertaining brain workout. Each letter in the quote is linked to a letter in one of the clue answers. As you fill
bluejetty:00015947:ios.description:
Acrostic puzzles are crosswords with a twist: find the hidden quote. This combination of crossword and cryptogram provides an entertaining brain workout. Each letter in the quote is linked to a letter in one of the clue answers. As you fill in more and more answers, more letters will begin to fill the quote grid, until eventually the entire quote is revealed. Once the quote is partially filled in, you can also do this process in reverse – each letter you add to the quote will fill in the corresponding letter in the clue answers. By working back-and-forth, eventually the entire quote and all clue answers will be revealed.
The app includes 60 free quality puzzles with no ads, ever. They range from beginner to expert from renowned publishers like Acrostica, Acrostics by Cyn, Lovatts Puzzles, PennyPress Anacrostics, Puzzle Baron and Spanish language puzzles from Tav Ripo. Additional puzzle packs containing 48 to 50 puzzles are available for a small fee; the full library is 7100 puzzles!
Advanced play features include automatic grid updating and indexing, see related cells, multi-level undo, remove errors, and hints. A wide range of difficulty levels will challenge beginners and seasoned players alike.
If you like word games, crosswords or cryptograms, acrostic puzzles are a fun way to exercise your brain!
Quality Software by Egghead Games. Contact us at support@eggheadgames.com or www.eggheadgames.com. We stand by our products and will happily refund your purchase if you’re not completely happy.

apple-macos:6786018687.name: Recito: Teleprompter for Video
apple-macos:6786018687.description:
Recito is a teleprompter app that records your video, on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your script sits right under the lens, over the live camera, so you look into the camera, not down at your notes.
No account and no subscription: Recito Pro is a one-time purchase, and one purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac. No cloud: everything stays on your device.
THE TELEPROMPTER, DONE RIGHT
- The script sits high under the lens on a frosted, legible scrim — reading reads as eye contact.
- Adjust font size and scroll speed with a slider.
- Preview the scroll before you record to dial in your pace.
- Grab the text with your finger to scrub it mid-take.
- Mirror mode for beam-splitter teleprompter rigs.
ON IPAD TOO
- Full screen in landscape or portrait, or beside another app; readable at arm's length.
PAUSE WITHOUT LOSING THE TAKE
- Pause mid-script and the teleprompter freezes on the word you stopped at — carry on from exactly there.
- You still get ONE video. The pauses are invisible in the result.
- Fluffed a line? Delete just that part and record it again; the script rewinds with it.
RECORD AND REVIEW
- 3-2-1 countdown, then record like the stock Camera.
- Front or rear camera, portrait, with audio.
- Camera controls: tap to focus, hold for AE/AF lock, a level and a grid.
- Shoot several takes and play them back.
- A pace coach reads your delivery in words-per-minute — relaxed, great, or a touch fast.
- Keep the best take; it saves straight to Photos, ready for Reels, Shorts, or TikTok.
WORD-BY-WORD CAPTIONS (RECITO PRO)
- After a take, your script's words are timed to your own voice, on your device.
- Four styles. Auto finds your face and puts them under it when there's room; or choose top, middle or bottom.
- Lines Recito wasn't sure of are marked for you to check, and you can retype any line.
- Burned in when you save. iOS 26, in languages your device recognises on-device.
IT FOLLOWS YOUR VOICE
- Just read. The script keeps pace with you — speed up, slow down, pause to think, and the words stay where your eyes are.
- No speed to set and nothing to hold. Your hands stay free for the take.
- The word you are reading is marked, at the top of the band or in the middle, whichever you prefer.
- Recognition runs entirely on your device. Nothing is recorded, uploaded or kept — there is no account and no network involved.
- The language comes from the script itself, so there is nothing to choose. It works in the languages your device can already recognise; the app tells you plainly when yours is not one of them.
- Included free, on every script you can write for free. It starts off, so the script scrolls at the speed you set; turn it on with the Voice button when you want it.
REMOTES AND KEYBOARDS
- A Bluetooth camera remote, the volume buttons or Camera Control start and pause your take. Finish with the checkmark.
- Apple Watch (Recito Pro): start, pause and finish a take from your wrist. Finish asks first.
- With a keyboard, page turner or presentation clicker: Space starts and pauses; during a take, the arrow keys move the script.
YOUR SCRIPTS, IN ORDER
- Folders, and your own order: drag scripts where you want them, or keep the last edited on top.
- On iPad, folders and scripts sit in a sidebar beside the script you're writing, as in Notes.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Recito collects nothing. The App Store privacy label reads "Data Not Collected."
- No analytics, no trackers, no network code outside Apple's StoreKit.
- Your scripts and videos never leave your device unless you save or share them.
ONE-TIME UNLOCK, NO SUBSCRIPTION
- Writing scripts, the teleprompter, voice-following, recording, and multiple takes are free.
- Recito Pro is a single one-time purchase: removes the watermark, allows unlimited-length scripts and adds captions and the Apple Watch remote.
- Restore it for free on any device on your Apple ID.
Questions? support@suprun.ca

apple-macos:6747931502.name: SimpleIPTV - IPTV & M3U Player
apple-macos:6747931502.description:
SimpleIPTV plays your own M3U playlists on iPhone and iPad. No account, no ads. You bring the playlist: the app does not sell or host any channels or content.
Highlights
• Add an Xtream Codes login next to your M3U playlists.
• Open playlists update by themselves, with progress, Cancel and Retry on screen.
• Download movies and episodes to watch offline.
• Casting starts from where you stopped.
• Pin your favorite groups to the top of the list.
• Redesigned movie and show screens, with the seasons in a rail.
Movies, shows and channels
• Posters, ratings, plot, cast and trailer links for movies and shows, from TMDB.
• Browse Channels, Movies and TV Shows separately.
• Filter movies and shows by genre, year and rating. Sort by name, recently added or rating.
• Shows open into seasons and episodes.
• Resume where you stopped. Episodes show progress and a watched mark, and the show button plays or resumes the next episode.
• Channels that come in several qualities (FHD, HD, SD) show as one row. Tap the row to pick a quality.
Playback that gets out of the way
• H.265/HEVC and other modern codecs play directly when the stream supports it, with automatic format conversion when it does not.
• Auto-retry recovers stalled streams without restarting the app.
• Picture in Picture.
• AirPlay to your TV and other AirPlay 2 receivers.
• Cast to Chromecast and Google TV from your iPhone or iPad. Casting keeps running through screen lock.
Playlists, organized
• Import from a URL or a file, or paste a link with one tap.
• Browse by group. Favorites and Recents have their own tabs, and search shows suggestions.
• Optional iCloud Sync keeps favorites, recents and watch progress in step across your devices. It stays off until you turn it on.
Accessibility
• Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and VoiceOver labels.
Privacy
There is no account and no login. Your playlists are stored on your device. iCloud Sync is optional and uses your own iCloud account. The app does not track what you watch.
To show posters and details, SimpleIPTV sends movie and show titles from your playlist to its metadata service. Stream addresses are not sent. Turn off Enrich Movies and Shows in Settings to stop sending titles to the metadata service.
Movie and show information comes from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Made for
• Personal M3U setups and home media servers
• Self-hosted streams from NAS or local network sources
• Educational, corporate, and broadcaster-supplied playlists
• Developers testing M3U/M3U8 streams
Note: SimpleIPTV is a player. You bring your own M3U playlist URL or file. We do not sell or host any channels or content.
SimpleIPTV Premium
• 90 days free from first install.
• After the trial, a yearly subscription is needed to keep watching. It renews automatically at the App Store price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends.
• Restore Purchases is available on the paywall and in Settings. Family Sharing is supported.
Screenshots show open movies by the Blender Foundation (CC BY).
Privacy policy: https://simpleiptv.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://simpleiptv.app/terms.html

fdroid:io.payanam.name: Payanam
fdroid:io.payanam.summary: Navigate your life journey across dimensions privately
fdroid:io.payanam.description:
Payanam (பயணம் — "journey") is a privacy-first life dimension manager for Android. Track what matters to you across the dimensions of life you define.
 Your data stays on your device by default. You control what leaves it. No cloud of ours. No accounts. No tracking. No subscriptions. Payanam has no servers of its own.
 Life Dimensions 
Comes with 9 default dimensions — Work & Livelihood, Physical Health, Family & Relationships, Home Environment, Money & Finance, Mental Health, Recreation & Leisure, Learning & Growth, Community & Service. Customize names, icons, colors, or create your own. Set per-dimension weightage that controls how each life area contributes to your scores.
 Habits — The Core 
The most mature module. Habits are recurring tasks with frequency-aware scheduling (daily, weekly, or X times per Y days). Every completion cascades through a 3-level metric system — habit-level (score, streaks, progress) → dimension-level (weighted average with carry-forward) → day-level aggregate. Dedicated habits insights include a score matrix (6 metrics, 14-day sparklines, rankings) and a dimension-spread radar chart comparing today's scores against your running average.
 Tasks 
Full CRUD with a 6-factor priority scoring engine (dimension importance, impact, goal alignment, energy, control, duration) — all configurable weights. Set due dates, tags, reminders, recurrence, and track occurrence history. Stopping time tracking auto-completes the linked task.
 Time Tracking 
Per-dimension time blocks with focus rating (0.0–1.0). Manual sessions: pick a dimension, start, stop. Habit auto-track: completing a habit auto-creates a time entry (opt-in per dimension, 15-min default). Both paths write to the same time store — there's no separate "habit time" vs "task time." Day-plan allocations let you set planned minutes per dimension; a Gaussian model scores how well actual time matches your plan.
 Journal 
Two levels per day: overall day reflection + per-dimension prompts. Both independently fillable each day.
 Insights & Lenses 
Opt-in by design — pick and enable exactly which charts you want (score cards, trends, heatmaps, radar, splits, timelines). Lenses build planning-vs-reality snapshots from time entries, task occurrences, and day-plan allocations. Five reflection card types detect untracked time, missed tasks, missed habits, focus gaps, and dimension gaps. Some chart metrics are still evolving — marked as pending in-app.
 Day Planning 
Template-based with auto/custom modes. Set planned minutes per dimension, with weekday/weekend preferences. Feeds time-deviation scoring and Lenses.
 Scoring Configuration 
Fine-grained control: adjust 6 cross-task factor weights plus per-level values for impact, goal alignment, energy, and control. Your priorities, your formula.
 Security & Backup 
Encrypted by default — set a strong passphrase (12+ chars, upper/lower/digit/symbol) on first launch. Optional biometric unlock with configurable auto-lock timeout (1 min to 4 hours). Auto-backup on configurable intervals (15 min to 24 hours) with rotation. Manual encrypted export/import with passphrase. Export logs from settings or the unlock screen.
 Customization 
Enable or disable individual modules. Choose your default home tab. System theme with Material You dynamic colors. English and Tamil locale support. Font family customization (sans, serif, monospace, cursive).
 Cross-Platform & Updates 
Android is in good shape. Windows desktop in early development. Linux and other platforms planned. Goal: fully featured cross-platform apps with same data, features, and privacy. GitHub builds include an in-app update checker (dev/beta/stable, opt-in). The F-Droid build has no in-app updates — update through your F-Droid client.
